_comment: HW-8's disclosed host changes as rules for tools/hostcheck.py. `change` is the broker/hostchange ID the owner's guide carries; a difference no rule matches fails the check. `key` is a regex on the finding key (UEFI: guid:name, TPM: handle); `changes` lists the allowed kinds of difference; `requires` names a run flag the operator sets.

rules.why: HW-6: only if the owner changes the boot order; the one-time boot key leaves it alone
systemd-boot's token, unless the image turns it off (P2-1)
a persistent SRK at the standard handle, only if the TPM held none
V6 rollback counter as broker/tpmseal/counter.go defines it: owner range, counter, authread|authwrite|no_da, 8 bytes
D7: lockout authorization and dictionary-attack settings while a boot PIN is on
